page.title: Vardath Kopis Production Cheat
page.t: Experimental Terran Kopis conversion: massive universal freight, Dart-like agility, a slowly self-producing economy cargo supply and nearby station build-storage logistics. Can carry building and cargo drones and 250 people. Weapons include an enhanced Terran Mk2 laser and an experimental dorsal turret connection.
Terran Mk2 laser derivative with 10 more base damage per shot (90 versus 80).
